# orchestra_assets (Data Source)

Data assets registered in Orchestra, optionally filtered. All matching pages are fetched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Unhealthy Snowflake assets in one schema. All pages are fetched.
data "orchestra_assets" "unhealthy" {
  integration = "SNOWFLAKE"
  schema_name = "ANALYTICS"
  status      = "UNHEALTHY"

  sort_column    = "last_updated_in_integration"
  sort_direction = "desc"
}

output "unhealthy_asset_names" {
  value = [for a in data.orchestra_assets.unhealthy.results : a.asset_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `asset_ids` (String) Comma-separated asset IDs to restrict the result to.
- `asset_type` (String) Filter by asset type.
- `database_name` (String) Filter by database name.
- `integration` (String) Filter by the integration the asset came from.
- `integration_account_id` (String) Filter by the account ID within the integration.
- `page_size` (Number) Items fetched per request (1-100, default 100). Every matching page is fetched regardless; this only tunes the request size.
- `schema_name` (String) Filter by schema name.
- `sort_column` (String) Column to sort by.
- `sort_direction` (String) Sort direction.
- `status` (String) Filter by asset health status.
- `workspace_id` (String) Filter by workspace ID.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Matching assets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) Account the asset belongs to.
- `asset_id` (String) Orchestra's ID for the asset.
- `asset_name` (String) Asset name.
- `asset_type` (String) Asset type.
- `bytes` (Number) Size in bytes.
- `connection` (String) Connection the asset was discovered through.
- `connection_integration` (String) Integration of that connection.
- `created_at` (String) When Orchestra first saw the asset.
- `created_in_integration` (String) When the asset was created in the source system.
- `database_name` (String) Database name.
- `description` (String) Asset description.
- `downstream_dependencies` (List of String) Asset IDs that depend on this asset.
- `external_id` (String) The asset's ID in the source integration.
- `freshness_config` (String) Freshness configuration, as JSON. The API declares this free-form.
- `integration` (String) Integration the asset came from.
- `integration_account_id` (String) Account ID within the integration.
- `integration_asset_type` (String) The integration's own name for this asset type.
- `last_updated_in_integration` (String) When the asset was last updated in the source system.
- `last_viewed` (String) When the asset was last viewed.
- `meta` (String) Arbitrary asset metadata, as JSON. The API declares this free-form.
- `owner` (String) Primary owner.
- `owners` (List of String) All owners.
- `row_count` (Number) Row count.
- `schema_name` (String) Schema name.
- `status` (String) Asset health status.
- `table_name` (String) Table name.
- `unique_viewers` (Number) Distinct viewers.
- `updated_at` (String) When Orchestra last updated the asset.
- `upstream_dependencies` (List of String) Asset IDs this asset depends on.
- `url` (String) Link to the asset in the source system.
- `usage_percentage` (Number) Usage as a percentage.
- `view_count` (Number) View count.
- `view_count_from_timestamp` (String) Start of the window view_count covers.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID.
- `workspace_name` (String) Workspace name.
